1.explanation: All of the listed classes/functions are responsible for rendering individual tab items and the overall Tabs container. The Tab and ContainedTab components (both the legacy and next variants) currently support only a text label or arbitrary custom button but have no built-in handling for an icon-only mode — they lack a renderIcon prop and do not apply the necessary padding, width, or CSS modifier classes for a 48 px-wide icon-only tab. The top-level Tabs component orchestrates layout and overflow behavior and will need to account for the new icon-only styling and spacing rules at the container level as well. Modifying these classes/functions is required to introduce a proper icon-only variant that matches the provided designs.
1.bug_scenario: The design calls for an “icon-only” variant of both line-style Tabs and contained (solid background) Tabs. In the provided mockups you can see tabs rendered with only an icon (20 px square) centered in a 48 px-wide tab, with no text label. Currently the Tab components only support a text label (or a custom renderButton) and do not size themselves correctly for an icon-only layout, so an explicit “renderIcon” prop and associated style adjustments need to be added.

2.explanation: All of the Tab components (classic, next/Tab, and next/ContainedTab) are responsible for rendering the individual tab buttons. None of these implementations accept or handle a renderIcon prop or apply the fixed width/spacing needed for the icon‐only design. The class Tab (in Tab.js) and the functional Tab and ContainedTab (in next/) all have a hard‐coded button label and classNames that only cover text‐based tabs. To support the icon‐only variant, these classes/functions must be updated to: 1) accept a renderIcon prop (and remove or conditionally render the label), 2) apply a modifier class name (e.g. `${prefix}--tabs__nav-item--icon-only`), and 3) enforce the 48 px width and 20 px icon offset via inline styles or CSS in those render methods.
2.bug_scenario: The user is requesting an "icon‐only" variant for both the line (scrollable) and contained tabs. In the images you can see: each tab should be a fixed 48 px wide container with the icon centered (20 px from the left edge) and no text label. Currently the Tabs and ContainedTabs components always render a text label or an empty button when only an icon prop is provided, and the spacing/width isn’t constrained to the 48 px icon‐only design.
